```{r}
### Data normalization function
median_centering <- function(df) {
  df_norm <- as.data.frame(apply(df, 2, function(x) {
                        gMedian = median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
                        x - gMedian
  }
    ))
  return(df_norm)
}

df_scp <- median_centering(df_filter)


miss_cor <- data.frame(
  missing_rate    = rowSums(is.na(df_scp)) / ncol(df_scp),
  mean_abundance  = rowMeans(df_scp, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
theme_pub <- function(base_size = 10) {
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = base_size) %+replace%
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = base_size + 1, face = "bold"),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.ticks.length= unit(2, "mm"),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.title     = element_text(size = base_size),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = base_size - 1)
    )
}

find_missing_rate_elbow <- function(df_norm,
                                    span = 0.75,
                                    n_points = 1000,
                                    point_size = 0.8,
                                    point_alpha = 0.8,
                                    save_path = NULL,   
                                    group_name = NULL,
                                    tiff_width = 6,  
                                    tiff_height = 3.5,
                                    tiff_dpi = 600) {
  
  stopifnot(is.matrix(df_norm) || is.data.frame(df_norm))
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Please install 'ggplot2'.")
  if (!requireNamespace("scales", quietly = TRUE))  stop("Please install 'scales'.")
  
  df_norm <- as.matrix(df_norm)
  
  miss_cor <- data.frame(
    missing_rate   = rowSums(is.na(df_norm)) / ncol(df_norm),
    mean_abundance = rowMeans(df_norm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  fit <- stats::loess(mean_abundance ~ missing_rate, data = miss_cor, span = span)
  
  x_vals <- seq(min(miss_cor$missing_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
                max(miss_cor$missing_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
                length.out = n_points)
  y_vals <- stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(missing_rate = x_vals))
  
  keep   <- !is.na(y_vals)
  x_vals <- x_vals[keep]
  y_vals <- y_vals[keep]
  
  x_start <- x_vals[1];              y_start <- y_vals[1]
  x_end   <- x_vals[length(x_vals)]; y_end   <- y_vals[length(y_vals)]
  line_vec  <- c(x_end - x_start, y_end - y_start)
  norm_line <- sqrt(sum(line_vec^2))
  distances <- vapply(seq_along(x_vals), function(i) {
    point_vec <- c(x_vals[i] - x_start, y_vals[i] - y_start)
    abs(line_vec[1] * point_vec[2] - line_vec[2] * point_vec[1]) / norm_line
  }, numeric(1))
  max_index <- which.max(distances)
  elbow_x <- x_vals[max_index]
  elbow_y <- y_vals[max_index]
  
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  
  p <- ggplot(miss_cor, aes(x = missing_rate, y = mean_abundance)) +
    geom_point(size = point_size, alpha = point_alpha) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, span = span) +
    geom_abline(
      slope = (y_end - y_start) / (x_end - x_start),
      intercept = y_start - ((y_end - y_start) / (x_end - x_start)) * x_start,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(x = elbow_x, y = elbow_y), color = "red", size = 2) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = elbow_x, y = elbow_y + 4,
          label = paste0("Elbow @ ", scales::percent(elbow_x, accuracy = 0.001))),
      hjust = -0.2, vjust = -0.5, color = "red",
      size = 6 
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
    labs(
      title = "Elbow Point in 'Dataset CellCycle'",
      x = "Missing Rate",
      y = "Mean log2 Abundance"
    ) +
    theme_pub(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),   
    axis.text  = element_text(face = "bold")   
  )
  
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(filename = save_path, plot = p, device = "tiff",
           dpi = tiff_dpi, width = tiff_width, height = tiff_height,
           units = "in", compression = "lzw")
  }
  
  list(
    miss_cor = miss_cor,
    fit = fit,
    elbow = list(x = elbow_x, y = elbow_y),
    plot = p
  )
}
```

## Soft Hybrid Imputation
```{r}
soft_hybrid_impute <- function(df_rf, df_minProb, df_raw, 
                               r0 = NULL, x0 = NULL, a = 10, b = 5, lambda = 0.5,
                               visualize = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(all(dim(df_rf) == dim(df_minProb)))
  stopifnot(all(rownames(df_rf) == rownames(df_minProb)))

  missing_rate <- rowMeans(is.na(df_raw))
  mean_intensity <- rowMeans(df_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  r0 <- elbow_x
  x0 <- elbow_y

  sigmoid <- function(x, k, x0) {
    1 / (1 + exp(-k * (x - x0)))
  }
  sigmoid_r <- sigmoid(missing_rate, k = a, x0 = r0)
  sigmoid_x <- sigmoid(mean_intensity, k = b, x0 = x0)
  p_MNAR <- sigmoid_r * (1 - lambda * sigmoid_x)

  df_imp_soft <- df_rf
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_rf))) {
    w <- 1 - p_MNAR[i]
    df_imp_soft[i, ] <- w * df_rf[i, ] + (1 - w) * df_minProb[i, ]
  }

  if (visualize) {
    library(ggplot2)
    df_plot <- data.frame(
      Protein = rownames(df_rf),
      MissingRate = missing_rate,
      MeanIntensity = mean_intensity,
      Weight_RF = 1 - p_MNAR
    )
     p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = MissingRate, y = MeanIntensity, color = Weight_RF)) +
        geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
        scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Soft Hybrid Weights in 'Dataset CellCycle'"),
      x = "Missing Rate",
      y = "Mean log2 Abundance"
    ) +
    theme_pub(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),  
      axis.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 12)   
    )
    print(p)
    ggsave(
      filename = './figure/plot_SH.tiff', 
         plot = p, 
         device = "tiff",
         dpi = 300,
         width = 6, 
         height = 4.5,
         units = "in"
    )
     }
  return(df_imp_soft)
}

```

# Helper Functions
```{r}
annotate_stage <- function(cell_names) {
  stage <- ifelse(grepl("_G1_", cell_names), "G1",
           ifelse(grepl("_TB_", cell_names), "G1-S",
           ifelse(grepl("_G2_", cell_names), "G2",
           ifelse(grepl("_NB_", cell_names), "G2-M", "other"))))
  names(stage) <- cell_names
  stage
}

read_cell_cycle_markers <- function(marker_file, sheet = "Tami_Geiger", expr_genes = NULL) {
  cc_markers <- read_excel(marker_file, sheet = sheet)
  
  g1_list  <- cc_markers$G1[2:(nrow(cc_markers)-1)]  %>% unlist() %>% na.omit() %>% as.character()
  s_list   <- cc_markers$S[2:(nrow(cc_markers)-1)]   %>% unlist() %>% na.omit() %>% as.character()
  g2m_list <- cc_markers$G2M[2:(nrow(cc_markers)-1)] %>% unlist() %>% na.omit() %>% as.character()
  
  if (!is.null(expr_genes)) {
    g1_list  <- intersect(g1_list, expr_genes)
    s_list   <- intersect(s_list, expr_genes)
    g2m_list <- intersect(g2m_list, expr_genes)
  }
  
  list(
    G1 = unique(g1_list),
    S = unique(s_list),
    G2M = unique(g2m_list)
  )
}

score_genes_scanpy_like <- function(expr_gene_by_cell,
                                    gene_list,
                                    n_bins = 25,
                                    ctrl_size = 50,
                                    seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  gene_list <- intersect(gene_list, rownames(expr_gene_by_cell))
  if (length(gene_list) < 2) stop("Too few marker genes left.")
  
  gene_means <- rowMeans(expr_gene_by_cell, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  ord <- order(gene_means)
  bins <- rep(seq_len(n_bins), length.out = length(gene_means))
  bin_assign <- integer(length(gene_means))
  bin_assign[ord] <- bins
  names(bin_assign) <- rownames(expr_gene_by_cell)
  
  ctrl_genes <- c()
  all_genes <- rownames(expr_gene_by_cell)
  
  for (g in gene_list) {
    b <- bin_assign[g]
    pool <- all_genes[bin_assign == b]
    pool <- setdiff(pool, gene_list)
    if (length(pool) == 0) next
    n_pick <- min(ctrl_size, length(pool))
    ctrl_genes <- c(ctrl_genes, sample(pool, n_pick, replace = FALSE))
  }
  
  ctrl_genes <- unique(ctrl_genes)
  if (length(ctrl_genes) < 2) stop("Too few control genes selected.")
  
  target_score <- colMeans(expr_gene_by_cell[gene_list, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  ctrl_score   <- colMeans(expr_gene_by_cell[ctrl_genes, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  target_score - ctrl_score
}

run_notebook_roc_strategy <- function(score_df, stage_vec) {
  stopifnot(all(score_df$cell == names(stage_vec)))
  
  df <- score_df %>%
    mutate(stage = unname(stage_vec[cell]))
  
  roc_list <- list()
  auc_list <- list()
  
  ## 1) G2-M vs G1-S
  sub1 <- df %>% filter(stage %in% c("G2-M", "G1-S"))
  score_map1 <- list(
    "G2-M" = sub1$g2m,
    "S"    = sub1$s,
    "G1"   = sub1$g1
  )
  
  for (phase in names(score_map1)) {
    true_label <- sapply(sub1$stage, function(a) grepl(phase, a, fixed = TRUE))
    roc_obj <- roc(response = true_label, predictor = score_map1[[phase]], quiet = TRUE)
    nm <- paste("G2-M_vs_G1-S", phase, sep = "__")
    roc_list[[nm]] <- roc_obj
    auc_list[[nm]] <- tibble(
      comparison = "G2-M_vs_G1-S",
      phase_score = phase,
      auc = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
    )
  }
  
  ## 2) G2 vs G1 ; 3) G2-M vs G1
  for (pair in list(c("G2", "G1"), c("G2-M", "G1"))) {
    subdf <- df %>% filter(stage %in% pair)
    score_map <- list(
      "G2-M" = subdf$g2m,
      "S"    = subdf$s,
      "G1"   = subdf$g1
    )
    
    for (phase in names(score_map)) {
      true_label <- sapply(subdf$stage, function(a) {
        grepl(phase, a, fixed = TRUE) ||
          (phase == "S" && a == "G1") ||
          grepl(a, phase, fixed = TRUE)
      })
      roc_obj <- roc(response = true_label, predictor = score_map[[phase]], quiet = TRUE)
      comp_name <- paste(pair[1], "vs", pair[2], sep = "_")
      nm <- paste(comp_name, phase, sep = "__")
      roc_list[[nm]] <- roc_obj
      auc_list[[nm]] <- tibble(
        comparison = comp_name,
        phase_score = phase,
        auc = as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
      )
    }
  }
  
  list(
    roc_list = roc_list,
    auc_table = bind_rows(auc_list)
  )
}
```

# Grid Tuning Functions
```{r}
score_one_param_by_roc_precomputed <- function(df_raw,
                                               df_rf,
                                               df_minProb,
                                               marker_file,
                                               a, b, lambda,
                                               marker_sheet = "Tami_Geiger",
                                               seed = 123,
                                               do_median_norm = FALSE) {

  stopifnot(!is.null(dim(df_raw)))
  stopifnot(!is.null(dim(df_rf)))
  stopifnot(!is.null(dim(df_minProb)))
  stopifnot(identical(dim(df_raw), dim(df_rf)))
  stopifnot(identical(dim(df_raw), dim(df_minProb)))
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(df_raw), rownames(df_rf)))
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(df_raw), colnames(df_rf)))
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(df_raw), rownames(df_minProb)))
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(df_raw), colnames(df_minProb)))

  if (do_median_norm) {
    df_raw_use <- median_normalise_pxcell(df_raw)
  } else {
    df_raw_use <- df_raw
  }

  df_soft <- soft_hybrid_impute(
    df_rf = df_rf,
    df_minProb = df_minProb,
    df_raw = df_raw_use,
    a = a,
    b = b,
    lambda = lambda,
    visualize = FALSE
  )

  stage <- annotate_stage(colnames(df_soft))
  keep_stage <- stage != "other"

  expr <- df_soft[, keep_stage, drop = FALSE]
  stage_use <- stage[keep_stage]

  markers <- read_cell_cycle_markers(
    marker_file = marker_file,
    sheet = marker_sheet,
    expr_genes = rownames(expr)
  )

  score_df <- tibble(
    cell = colnames(expr),
    g1  = score_genes_scanpy_like(expr, markers$G1,  seed = seed),
    s   = score_genes_scanpy_like(expr, markers$S,   seed = seed),
    g2m = score_genes_scanpy_like(expr, markers$G2M, seed = seed)
  )

  roc_res <- run_notebook_roc_strategy(score_df, stage_use)

  summary_df <- roc_res$auc_table %>%
    summarise(
      mean_auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_auc = median(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_auc = min(auc, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    mutate(a = a, b = b, lambda = lambda) %>%
    dplyr::select(a, b, lambda, everything())

  list(
    summary = summary_df,
    auc_table = roc_res$auc_table,
    score_df = score_df,
    imputed = df_soft
  )
}

run_grid_roc_tuning <- function(df_scp,
                                imp_all,
                                minProb_all,
                                marker_file,
                                grid_df,
                                marker_sheet = "Tami_Geiger",
                                seed = 123,
                                do_median_norm = FALSE) {

  stopifnot(!is.null(dim(df_scp)))
  stopifnot(!is.null(dim(imp_all)))
  stopifnot(!is.null(dim(minProb_all)))

  stopifnot(identical(dim(df_scp), dim(imp_all)))
  stopifnot(identical(dim(df_scp), dim(minProb_all)))
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(df_scp), rownames(imp_all)))
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(df_scp), colnames(imp_all)))
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(df_scp), rownames(minProb_all)))
  stopifnot(identical(colnames(df_scp), colnames(minProb_all)))

  message("Input matrix: ", nrow(df_scp), " proteins x ", ncol(df_scp), " cells")

  all_summary <- vector("list", nrow(grid_df))
  all_auc <- vector("list", nrow(grid_df))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid_df))) {
    a <- grid_df$a[i]
    b <- grid_df$b[i]
    lambda <- grid_df$lambda[i]

    cat(sprintf("Running %d/%d | a=%s b=%s lambda=%s\n",
                i, nrow(grid_df), a, b, lambda))

    res_i <- score_one_param_by_roc_precomputed(
      df_raw = df_scp,
      df_rf = imp_all,
      df_minProb = minProb_all,
      marker_file = marker_file,
      a = a,
      b = b,
      lambda = lambda,
      marker_sheet = marker_sheet,
      seed = seed,
      do_median_norm = do_median_norm
    )

    all_summary[[i]] <- res_i$summary
    all_auc[[i]] <- res_i$auc_table %>%
      mutate(a = a, b = b, lambda = lambda)
  }

  summary_df <- bind_rows(all_summary) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_auc), desc(min_auc))

  auc_df <- bind_rows(all_auc)

  list(
    raw = df_scp,
    rf = imp_all,
    minProb = minProb_all,
    summary_df = summary_df,
    auc_df = auc_df
  )
}
```

```{r}
lambda_curve_df <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(lambda) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_meanAUC = mean(mean_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_meanAUC   = sd(mean_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    best_meanAUC = max(mean_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_lambda_curve <- ggplot(lambda_curve_df, aes(x = lambda)) +
  # mean curve
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_meanAUC, color = "Mean AUC"), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_meanAUC, color = "Mean AUC"), size = 2.5) +
  # best curve
  geom_line(aes(y = best_meanAUC, color = "Best AUC"), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = best_meanAUC, color = "Best AUC"), size = 2.8) +
  # error bar（只属于 mean）
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_meanAUC - sd_meanAUC,
      ymax = mean_meanAUC + sd_meanAUC
    ),
    width = 0.02,
    color = "grey50",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,   
    values = c(
      "Mean AUC" = "grey40",
      "Best AUC" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(lambda_curve_df$lambda)),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(y) sprintf("%.3f", y)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(lambda),
    y = "mean AUC",
    title = "Global lambda tuning: Dataset CellCycle",
    subtitle = "(Brunner et al.)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(color = "black", size = 12.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(color = "black", size = 12.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
    face = "italic",
    hjust = 1   
  ),
    legend.position = "right",  
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

p_lambda_curve
```
```{r}
lambda_sel <- c(0.1, 0.4, 0.5, 0.9)

heatmap_df_multi_lambda <- plot_df %>%
  filter(lambda %in% c(0.1, 0.4, 0.5, 0.9)) %>%
  mutate(
    lambda = round(lambda, 2),
    lambda = factor(lambda, levels = c(0.1, 0.4, 0.5, 0.9))
  )
levels(heatmap_df_multi_lambda$lambda) <- c('lambda = 0.1', 'lambda = 0.4', 'lambda = 0.5', 'lambda = 0.9')

p_ab_heatmap_multi_lambda <- ggplot(
  heatmap_df_multi_lambda,
  aes(x = factor(a), y = factor(b), fill = mean_auc)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  #geom_text(
  #  aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_auc)),
  #  size = 3
  #) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FEE8C8", high = "#E34A33") +
  facet_wrap(~lambda, nrow = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Parameter a",
    y = "Parameter b",
    fill = "mean AUC",
    title = "Global a/b tuning: Dataset CellCycle",
    subtitle = "(Brunner et al.)"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    text              = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(
    face = "italic",
    hjust = 1   
  ),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 12.5, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(color = "black", size = 12.5, face = "bold",
                                  angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(color = "black", size = 12.5, face = "bold"), 
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks.length.y = unit(2, "mm"),
    panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    legend.position   = "right",
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    strip.text        = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
  )
```
